meta.title: Cook App
meta.description: Store your recipes in your WordPress. All the basics like ingredients, step, portion calculator. Paste a URL to pull a recipe in from the web. AI enabled so that you can get help with adapting and creating new recipes.
meta.author: Alex Kirk
